merchantx_poc: Hi team — MerchantX here. We need to onboard a custom multilingual summarizer (compact ~7B) for invoice summarization across EN/ES/FR. Requirements: PHI/PII masking, private deployment (VPC/on‑prem), HSM for keys, and cost constraints — can we run quantized (4-bit) to cut costs? Also need evals for PHI masking recall, summary ROUGE, and latency p95 < 150ms. Timeline: pilot in 3 weeks.
jamie_cs: Thanks — noted. Can you confirm dataset size, whether training or just adapter/fine-tune, and expected QPS? Also is strict SLAs required for p95 or just internal target?
merchantx_poc: We have ~25k invoices for eval (anonymized), adapter fine-tune only (no full retrain), steady QPS ~6rps with bursts to 20. p95 target is customer SLA — they will push on renewal if latency is worse.
jamie_cs: Ok — we're likely to suggest Dedicated vs Private Dedicated. For HSM + on‑prem we'll need infra intake. I'll set up an enablement playbook. cc @oliver_se for quant tradeoffs and canary plan.
oliver_se: 4-bit quant is doable for 7B but expect slight decode overhead and possibly lower PHI detection FNR. We should run an eval sweep: FP/FN for PHI masking, ROUGE-L, and token-level hallucination checks. Example service config we'd test:
```
model: merchantx-sum-7b
precision: q4_0
batching:
  max_tokens: 1024
  batch_timeout_ms: 12
routing:
  primary: private-dedicated
  fallback: hosted-7b-compat
```
I'll run a perf sim for p95 under QPS 6/20.
maria_safety: Important: define PHI masking metric as 'recall of PHI spans' and set acceptable false negative rate <= 0.1% initially. Also need sample-level human review for 500 cases before rollout. Please attach PII schema and redaction rules.
merchantx_poc: PII schema attached via secure share (link in DM). We can do 500 human reviews; can provide stratified sample across languages.
jamie_cs: Great. I'll open a ticket for Private onboarding and link the intake form: https://redwood.internal/onboard-intake (fill dataset link, KMS/HSM details, compliance contact). We may need a 2-week canary with automatic fallback to hosted model if latency >200ms.
deploy-bot: deploy-checklist: infra-ticket #CS-7864 created; canary window set to 14d; test cluster scheduled 48h.
merchantx_poc: Thanks — will fill form today. Any recommended eval scripts? Prefer ones that output PHI span F1 and latency distro.
oliver_se: I'll share a lightweight eval runner (python) in #eng-ml. It exports: 'phi_recall', 'phi_fnr', 'rouge_l', 'p95_latency_ms'. Use seed=42 for sampling.
jamie_cs: Sounds good. I'll track risks for renewal — flagging this as 'high' if canary fails. Will follow up with enablement call tomorrow 10am PST.
merchantx_poc: 10am works. Appreciate the quick turnaround :pray:
jamie_cs: :thumbsup:
